items.name: curved-wall
items.title: Curved Image Wall
items.description: Screens on a 3D ring you can drag and fling. It drifts while idle, steps with the arrow keys, pauses off screen and stays still under reduced motion.
items.docs: Import it with `import { CurvedWall } from "@/components/curved-wall"`. Live demo, props and a usage example: https://www.easeoutstudio.com/lab/curved-wall

items.name: pixel-select
items.title: Pixel Select
items.description: A select whose menu assembles out of pixels when it opens and dissolves back into the pill when you pick. Accessible listbox, reduced-motion fade, canvas runs only while pixels move.
items.docs: Import it with `import { PixelSelect } from "@/components/pixel-select"`. Live demo, props and a usage example: https://www.easeoutstudio.com/lab/pixel-select

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A pill that opens into code slots, verifies, and shakes and clears on a wrong code. Paste and SMS autofill work.
items.docs: Import it with `import { OtpInput } from "@/components/otp-input"`. Live demo, props and a usage example: https://www.easeoutstudio.com/lab/otp-input

items.name: magnetic-dock
items.title: Magnetic Dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock: icons swell under the cursor on critically damped springs.
items.docs: Import it with `import { MagneticDock } from "@/components/magnetic-dock"`. Live demo, props and a usage example: https://www.easeoutstudio.com/lab/magnetic-dock

items.name: flip-button
items.title: Flip Button
items.description: A button whose fill sweeps in, label flips letter by letter, and primary variant leans toward the cursor.
items.docs: Import it with `import { FlipButton } from "@/components/flip-button"`. Live demo, props and a usage example: https://www.easeoutstudio.com/lab/flip-button

items.name: spring-slider
items.title: Spring Compare Slider
items.description: A before/after slider that settles on a spring. Drag, click or use the arrow keys.
items.docs: Import it with `import { SpringSlider } from "@/components/spring-slider"`. Live demo, props and a usage example: https://www.easeoutstudio.com/lab/spring-slider
